description: Stores the business's SOP, handbook or checklist files privately for the Serviche team to turn into Flows and recurring tasks, as the Get started card's Drop or upload your SOP documents does. Send up to 10 files; each is a file_name plus its content, as content_base64 for a binary file (PDF, Word, Excel, image) or content_text for plain text or markdown. A PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, text, markdown, CSV, PNG, JPEG or WebP file is accepted, 25 MB each at most, and the kind is checked from the bytes. read entity company_documents lists what the business has uploaded. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the documents the first call stored.

content_base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded, for a binary file.

content_text.description: The file text, for a plain text or markdown file.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: upload_company_documents
title: Upload the business's SOP documents
